verifications.claim: Graco has issued a voluntary recall for approximately 5,126 SnugRide Turn & Slide Rotating Infant Car Seats manufactured Dec 1, 2025–March 27, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Graco is recalling 5,126 car seats... manufactured between Dec. 1, 2025, and March 27, 2026.'; R5: 'Graco has recalled 5,126 certain SnugRide Turn & Slide...'
verifications.reasoning: Exact number, product name, and manufacture dates directly match R3; number and product match R5; voluntary noted across sources.

verifications.claim: The recall is due to a structural defect where the seat may detach from the base during a crash.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'structural issue with the base'; R3: 'infant seat carrier may detach from the base in a crash'; R5: 'they may detach from the base during a crash'; R7: 'structural issue identified during a post-production laboratory test.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state structural issue causing detachment in crash.

verifications.claim: The affected products were sold between January and March 2026 at major retailers.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'sold in the U.S. from Jan through March 2026 at Amazon, Babylist, Target, Walmart and on GracoBaby.com.' (repeated across all sources)
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm exact sales period and list major retailers like Amazon, Target, Walmart.

verifications.claim: The affected models are SnugRide Turn & Slide models numbers 2231809, 2231887, 2231806, 2231885, 2231881, 2231884.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '2231809, Noir / Black; 2231887, Sandstone / Tan; 2231806, Mulberry / Girl-Plum; 2231885, Sandstone / Tan; 2231881, Noir / Black; 2231884, Noir / Black' (exact list matches across sources).
verifications.reasoning: Exact model numbers listed for SnugRide Turn & Slide in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: No other Graco products or rotating car seats are affected.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'No other Graco car seats are affected... including EasyTurn and Turn2Me. No other SnugRide models.'; R6: 'no other Graco rotating car seats are affected, including EasyTurn and Turn2Me'; R7: 'No other Graco rotating car seats are affected, including EasyTurn and Turn2Me. No other SnugRide models.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state no other Graco car seats or rotating models affected.

verifications.claim: The car seat base has a white label with the model number and manufactured date.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Upload a photo of the white label found on the base'; R4: 'white label on the car seat base to find the model number, date of manufacture'; R7: 'white label on the base showing the model number, date of manufacture, and serial number.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources describe white label on base with model number and date of manufacture.

verifications.claim: The seat can still be used for travel without the base installed via seat belt.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'current seat may continue to be used without the base'; R3: 'install the child seat using the vehicle seat belt without the base'; R7: 'current seat may continue to be used without the base in accordance with the product instructions.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm seat usable without base (seat belt implied/standard for infant seats).

verifications.claim: A free replacement kit is available.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'provide a replacement product at no cost'; R7: 'provide a replacement product at no cost'; lists specific 'replacement options' like seats and bases.
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm free replacement product/options; 'kit' aligns closely with bundled replacements.

verifications.claim: There is an official Graco SnugRide Turn & Slide Recall website.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R7: 'https://recalls.gracobaby.com/' titled 'Graco SnugRide Turn & Slide Recall'; others reference 'recalls.gracobaby.com'.
verifications.reasoning: R7 is the official site; others direct to it.

verifications.claim: There is an Instagram post regarding the Graco Turn & Slide recall.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No reference mentions an Instagram post.
